question: What are the name of badges that users who have the lowest reputation obtained?
evidence: lowest reputation refers to Min(Reputation); user refers to UserId
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
gold: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)
gold0: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)

b.request: For every user whose reputation equals the minimum user reputation, list their badge names, including a row with a null badge name if the user has no badges
b.sql: SELECT u.Id AS UserId, b.Name AS BadgeName FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)

c.request:
What are the name of badges that users who have the lowest reputation obtained?
Evidence: lowest reputation refers to Min(Reputation); user refers to UserId
Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
c.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)

d.request: What are the badge names for users with the lowest reputation? Include those users even if they have no matching badge record.
d.sql: SELECT u.Id AS UserId, u.DisplayName, b.Name AS BadgeName FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)
